name: Online Sequence, Knot & Number-Theory Databases
description: Mandatory lookup and unit-rescaling protocol across OEIS (JSON API across logged cumulants, unlogged exponentials, factorial-cleared and torsion-rescaled forms), KnotInfo / LinkInfo / SnapPy / Regina censuses, LMFDB, and >= 80 dps PSLQ constant recognition whenever computational or mathematical research encounters integer sequences, rational series coefficients, composite denominators, transcendental constants, or knot/link invariants.
